title: Collections Casebook: Statement Deferral after a Gate Lockout on the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Ruling.** Where a gate lockout notice has been sent in the current delinquency cycle of a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement, $7.00 is left on the next statement of the tenant bringing the agreement current when that notice was sent at least 14 days before the handling date, and $3.50 when it was sent fewer days before; where no gate lockout notice has been sent in the cycle, nothing is left on that account. The amount left is left on the next statement rather than collected: it is taken off the amount to pay now, and the result is rounded to the cent.

The current delinquency cycle is the one running from the agreement's delinquency date, the due date of the oldest unpaid period; a gate lockout notice belongs to it when its cycle runs from that date. Days are calendar days from the notice date to the handling date; where more than one gate lockout notice of the cycle exists, the latest is read.

### Cases (hypothetical, handling date 25 August)

1. Gate lockout notice of the current cycle dated 11 August: 14 days before. *Held:* $7.00.
2. Gate lockout notice of the current cycle dated 12 August: 13 days before. *Held:* $3.50.
3. Gate lockout notice dated 2 February, from a cycle that closed when that earlier delinquency was paid; none in the current cycle. *Held:* nothing.
4. No gate lockout notice at all. *Held:* nothing.
